prior_record_status_note: The prior computational-only record remains unchanged; experimental values first entered in this separate addendum.

K_TLC_Alexa488.construct: SC120074 hFTL cDNA in pRSET A; full fusion/junction/tag equivalence to reference remains unconfirmed
K_TLC_Alexa488.expression: E. coli T7 Express Crystal; pEVOL-pAzF; 1 mM IPTG and 1 mM pAzF added at OD600 0.8, harvest after 4 h; heat precipitation and FPLC purification
K_TLC_Alexa488.reaction: 1 µM final hFTL-X; hFTL-X:DBCO-AlexaFluor488 molar ratio 1:24, overnight at room temperature
K_TLC_Alexa488.assay: quantitative TLC; alumina-backed silica, mobile phase 75% methanol/25% ammonium acetate; conjugated versus free fluorophore
K_TLC_Alexa488.denominator_scope: Retain the reported percent fluorophore conjugated; not an incorporation fraction or independently measured probability of a subunit being labeled.
